I am an Economics major with a Data Science minor at Brigham Young University-Idaho (expected April 2028), with a 4.00 GPA and a full-ride merit scholarship. I also serve as president of the Economics Society and work as an Associate Research Fellow, where I help design randomized experiments that estimate causal effects on student performance.

My work centers on turning messy data into a clear answer: cleaning and joining datasets, choosing a defensible statistical model, and presenting the result so a non-technical reader can act on it.

**Tools:** Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Excel  
**Methods:** statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, machine learning, data visualization and storytelling
